parameters.jsonBody: {"query":"{ jobs(filters: { remote: true }, first: 50) { edges { node { title externalUrl company { name } locations { name } salaryRange { minSalary maxSalary currency } function skills { value } description } } } }"}

={
  "model": "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
  "max_tokens": 300,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule: Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says remote.
Reject if it requires the worker to live in US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any country outside Taiwan.
Reject if it requires local work authorization outside Taiwan.
Reject if it is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only.
Reject if it requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan (e.g. strict US EST/PST business hours).

Keep ONLY if one of these is true:
- worldwide remote / work from anywhere / global remote
- APAC remote / Asia-friendly
- allows international contractors
- company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement
- no geographic restriction mentioned

Return JSON only, no other text:
{
  "taiwan_eligible": "yes/no/unclear",
  "reason": "short reason under 30 words",
  "location_risk": "low/medium/high",
  "timezone_risk": "low/medium/high",
  "contractor_possible": "yes/no/unclear",
  "decision": "keep/reject/manual_check"
}

Job title: {{ $json.job_title }}
Company: {{ $json.company }}
Location: {{ $json.location_text }}
Tags: {{ $json.tags }}

Job description (first 2000 chars):
{{ $json.description.slice(0, 2000) }}"
    }
  ]
}

={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 600,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Write a short cover letter for Jerry applying to this role: {{ $json.job_title }} at {{ $json.company }}.

Jerry's background:
- Based in Taiwan, wants async global remote work
- Bilingual English and Mandarin (grew up in California and Taiwan)
- Digital marketing background + Data science bootcamp
- Skills: Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- Experience: performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Projects: dashboards, EDA, machine learning, customer segmentation, fraud detection, marketing analytics

Make the letter specific to this job. Mention how Jerry can help the company:
- reduce manual analysis time
- improve reporting speed
- connect marketing and data
- build AI-assisted workflows
- turn messy data into business action

Keep it under 220 words. Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate. No filler phrases like 'I am writing to express my interest.'

Job description context:
{{ $json.description.slice(0, 1500) }}"
    }
  ]
}
